accessNotes: design.fusionfabric.cloud no longer resolves (DNS failure) and has no Wayback snapshot; a web search found no copy of the data-visualization guideline text. The original GitHub repo finastra/finastra-design-system returns 404, but a public fork (xmonvoisin/finastra-design-system, 2022) contains the official chart implementations: the @finastra/charts web component (ApexCharts wrapper) whose default ChartTheme encodes the guide's named palettes (semantic 1-3, categorical, focus 1/2, focus angular, sequential 1/2 with label colours), the Angular uxg-chart (Plotly) palette defaults, and the FDS light/dark colour tokens. All values below come from that source code; prose rules from the guide (do/don'ts, layout) could not be read. No reference images were available (the only PNG in the repo was a placeholder icon).
summary: Finastra's FDS is an enterprise fintech product-UI system built on Material/Angular with Roboto. Its chart palettes are anchored on the brand violet #694ED6 and fuchsia/pink, with a six-colour categorical palette ending in a light grey 'other', explicit per-colour label (text) colours for contrast, two violet/pink 'focus' gradients that highlight against a neutral grey, and two nine-step sequential ramps.

colors.categoricalNotes: Web-component default 'categorical' palette (6 colours, last is neutral grey #E5E5E5, presumably for 'other'). Paired data-label colours: white on #694ED6, black on all others. Older Angular/Plotly colorway (8): #694ED6, #C137A2, #E40046, #56C271, #FF8A3D, #D2D755, #F0B323, #5BC1D7 (primary violet, secondary fuchsia, crimson, grass, amber, lime, gold, ocean). Palettes are overridable via CSS variables --fds-chart-categorical-palette etc.
colors.notes: Sequential-2 (pink): #571235, #7D214E, #A43067, #CA3F7F, #F04E98, #F470B2, #F891CC, #FBB3E5, #FFD4FF; sequential label colours switch from white to black at step 6 (seq-1) / step 5 (seq-2). Focus palettes (highlight vs neutral): focus-1 gradient #1379C4 -> #694ED6 with neutral #E5E5E5; focus-2 gradient #C34DD5 -> #F04E98 with neutral #E5E5E5; 'angular' (conic) variants add middle stops. Semantic palettes are monochrome shades (ApexCharts monochrome, shadeTo light, intensity 0.65) of #008744 (green, semantic-1), #D60040 (red, semantic-2), #FF600A (orange, semantic-3). Plotly colour scale: rgb(73,54,150) -> #694ED6 -> rgb(143,123,225) -> rgb(180,166,234) -> rgb(217,211,245) -> rgb(206,206,206). Slice/segment stroke = surface colour (#FFFFFF light, #242424 dark). FDS light: primary #694ED6, secondary #C137A2, surface #FFFFFF, on-surface #000000, outline black 12% alpha, on-surface-medium black 54%. Dark: primary #917EE0, secondary #E453BF, surface #242424. Charts re-render on prefers-color-scheme change.

typography.notes: Tooltip 12px Roboto; legend 12px Roboto weight 300 with on-surface text colour; Angular charts take body-1 Material typography for chart, axis and legend fonts.

structure.notes: Angular Plotly charts: paper_bgcolor and plot_bgcolor transparent, automargin axes, hovermode 'closest'; bargap derived from a CSS margin (default 10px -> 0.1).

legend.placement: bottom, centred (web-component default); Angular demos use vertical right-top
legend.notes: Legend items spaced 8px horizontally / 4px vertically with a 4px gap between marker and text; legend items are clickable (pointer cursor).

marks.pies: Pie and donut are the first-class implemented components; segments separated by a surface-coloured (white) stroke; expandOnClick configurable.

labels.dataLabels: On by default (hide-data-label to disable); 12px Roboto Light, no background or drop shadow; colour switches black/white per palette slot for contrast.

layout: Charts default to width 100% / height auto (responsive container).
interaction: Tooltip 12px Roboto, not filled with series colour, no marker; clickable legend; dark/light mode follows prefers-color-scheme.
accessibility: Every palette ships with a matching label-colour array so data labels keep contrast (white on dark violet / dark sequential steps, black on light ones).

chartTypes.notes: Web component exposes all ApexCharts types; pie and donut have dedicated implementations.

distinctiveRules.rule: Categorical palette leads with brand violet and ends with a neutral grey: #694ED6, #F04E98, #ED8B00, #FFD100, #7FCDDE, #E5E5E5.
Data labels are on by default in 12px Roboto Light, white on the violet slot and black on all lighter slots.
'Focus' palettes highlight the subject with a blue-to-violet (#1379C4 -> #694ED6) or purple-to-pink (#C34DD5 -> #F04E98) gradient against neutral grey #E5E5E5 for everything else.
Sequential palettes are 9-step ramps centred on brand violet (#2A285C ... #694ED6 ... #EDDDFF) or pink (#571235 ... #F04E98 ... #FFD4FF).
Semantic palettes are monochrome tints of a single status colour: green #008744, red #D60040, orange #FF600A.
distinctiveRules.quote: monochrome: { enabled: true, color: semanticPalette1, shadeTo: 'light', shadeIntensity: 0.65 }

distinctiveRules.rule: Legend sits below the chart, centred, 12px Roboto Light, items 8px apart.
Segments (pie/donut/stacks) are separated by a stroke in the surface colour (white in light, #242424 in dark).
Charts have transparent backgrounds and follow the OS light/dark preference (dark primary #917EE0).
